NQ.es: Dia 6 del corto: sobrevivio un salto al alza violento (barrio PDH, maximo de ciclo 27838) y cerro devolviendolo casi todo. Para Asia: el cierre de 1h de hoy bajo 26921.75 confirma que la sesion se queda con el corto, no lo fade. Plan: pullback 26900-26980 y continuacion (B, tope por vs24h with); rebote 26559-26660 es A+ por formula pero sin reclamo confirmado (SMT alcista como aviso). Nada de GO, estirado 6.9 ATR. Update Londres 01:23 CT: Asia rompio el target (26620) y casi el target2 (26233) del plan de pre-asia, mucho mas fuerte de lo previsto; ahora en 26299.5, 6 toques sin reclamo en 26271 (ONL/ASL). Para Londres: sin pullback a tiro (26603-26661 es WATCH, fuera de presupuesto), el unico jugable es el rebote tactico B en 26271-26324.5, sin GO. Rango restante del dia ~530pts.
NQ.en: Day 6 of the short: survived a violent upside spike (swept the PDH, cycle high 27838) and closed giving almost all of it back. For Asia: today's 1h close below 26921.75 confirms the session stays with the short, doesn't fade it. Plan: 26900-26980 pullback and continuation (B, capped by vs24h with); the 26559-26660 bounce is A+ by formula but without a confirmed reclaim (bullish SMT as a heads-up). No GO, stretched 6.9 ATR. London update 01:23 CT: Asia broke the pre-asia plan's target (26620) and nearly its target2 (26233), far stronger than expected; now at 26299.5, 6 touches with no reclaim at 26271 (ONL/ASL). For London: no pullback at reach (26603-26661 is WATCH, outside budget), the only playable thing is the tactical B bounce at 26271-26324.5, no GO. Day's remaining range ~530pts.
